tasks.title: Record two new direct sends and block duplicate initial outreach

Preserve the existing Junior Achievement of South Florida SENT event and its known recipient info@jasouthflorida.org without adding an event. Add an explicit DO_NOT_SEND_NEW_INITIAL_OUTREACH guard to these records and a reusable initial-outreach eligibility guard that blocks a duplicate by canonical organization identity or known recipient email, while allowing only separately authorized follow-up logic. Feed prior contacted organizations into Control Plane reconciliation so new signals remain ALREADY_CONTACTED rather than READY_TO_SEND. Distinguish unique organizations contacted from email events; expected direct unique 7, partner unique 5, total unique 12, and total sent events 12. Show Not yet configured for a null follow-up date. Add focused tests and a factual report. Do not send, enrich, or schedule any email; do not publish or change traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Project Oceanology and Rodale Institute each have exactly one date-confirmed direct SENT event dated 2026-08-18, with no invented send time or downstream outcome.
Junior Achievement of South Florida retains its original 2026-08-17 sent event and becomes no second record.
The canonical direct/partner unique-contacted counts are 7/5 and total unique contacted is 12; event count remains a separate metric of 12.
A new source or later import cannot make an organization with prior initial outreach eligible for a new initial send; the Control Plane state remains ALREADY_CONTACTED.
No follow-up due date is invented when no follow-up policy exists.
No send, enrichment, deployment, billing, or external action is implemented.
